summary: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, reporting a share capital increase and alteration. The company increased authorized capital from US$50,000 (50 million shares) to US$5 million (5 billion shares), then re-designated shares into Class A (1 vote/share) and Class B (50 votes/share). It repurchased 5.28 million Class A shares from Joyful Star Limited and 1.08 million from Green Circle Limited, issuing equivalent Class B shares as consideration. The board approved on July 17 and August 6; shareholders ratified at the August 10 EGM. This recapitalization concentrates voting control, not a return of cash. Watch for implications on corporate governance and potential future transactions.
